+/** Splits an array into two arrays based on a predicate. The first array contains elements the predicate accepted, the second contains rejected elements, both in their original order */
+function partition<T>(
+  f: (x: T, index: number, arr: T[]) => boolean,
+  list: readonly T[]
+): Tuple<T[], T[]>
+function partition<T>(
+  f: (x: T, index: number, arr: T[]) => boolean
+): (list: readonly T[]) => Tuple<T[], T[]>
+function partition<T>(
+  f: (x: T, index: number, arr: T[]) => boolean,
+  list?: readonly T[]
+): any {
+  switch (arguments.length) {
+    case 1:
+      return (list: readonly T[]) => partition(f, list)
+    default:
+      const res = [[], []] as [T[], T[]]
+      for (let i = 0; i < list!.length; i++) {
+        f(list![i], i, list!)
+          ? res[0].push(list![i])
+          : res[1].push(list![i])
+      }
+      return Tuple(res[0], res[1])
+  }
+}
